description: Hafeninformationen der Beweissicherung zur Baumaßnahme "Anpassung der Fahrrinne der Unter- und Außenelbe an die Containerschifffahrt" is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Important data of ports in the area of the Lower Elbe. The port database serves various purposes: 1. Evaluation of Elbefonds Foundation applications for eligible ports. 2. Determination of siltation rates and information on dredging methodologies in the various ports. 3. General information collection (operator, usage contracts, owner, object name and use) 4. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Port information of the preservation of evidence for the construction measure "Adaptation of the navigation channel of t" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Verschlickung, Hafendokumentation, Beweissicherung, Umweltüberwachung, wsv_topic:Beweissicherung, wsv_topic_code:BEWSIC. The listing shows 2010-04-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
